lines: Staff can now put a new event together, and keep it as a draft until it is ready.
The Events page lists every event, soonest first. Each row shows the date and time in Toronto, how many are going, and whether it is published.
All, Published and Draft each show a count. A tab with nothing in it says so.
New event opens the event editor at the side, with focus on the title. On a phone, it fills the screen.
Save draft sends the event. While it waits, the button says Saving, and the fields hold still.
Then the drawer closes, a toast says the draft is not visible to members yet, and the list shows it.
With no events yet, the page offers the first one. If the list does not load, Try again asks again.
On the server, every field has its limits, and a refusal names each field's own code. The start must be after now, in Toronto time.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
That's slice ten point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
